title: Koozie - “City Of Moorpark Celebrates 40 Years 1983-2023” California Can Holder
descriptionText: Holds cans and bottles securely with its sturdy construction, perfect for any outdoor gathering or picnic. Celebrate the 40-year anniversary of Moorpark, California with this collectible Koozie. Made in the United States, this can holder is a must-have for any fan of the city or collector of insulators. Add it to your collection today!
